verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the admin-facing 'manage-sharing' doc. It confirms external sharing in SharePoint and OneDrive is an administered capability, but the quoted text describes only that users can share outside the organization, not the governance controls themselves. Other items cover inside/outside sharing and the createLink API, which are user and developer features, not org-level policy. Missing for 10: documented org-level controls over who may share externally, domain allow/block lists, link-type or expiration restrictions, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
